items.title: Crowned Wooden King Nutcracker
items.alt: Wooden king nutcracker with an open gold crown, burgundy cape, white beard and long staff.
items.description: An open crown rises above a stern wooden face and curled white moustache. A burgundy cape, faceted boots and long staff frame the king's broad silhouette.

items.title: Wooden Drummer Nutcracker
items.alt: Green-jacketed drummer nutcracker with a blue cap, cream straps and a red drum.
items.description: A red drum hangs from cream straps across the drummer's green jacket. Rounded cheeks, a curled black moustache and short black boots give the figure a compact shape.

items.title: Braided Queen Nutcracker
items.alt: Tall wooden queen nutcracker with silver braids, a fan-shaped crown and a teal-and-gold coat.
items.description: Silver braids hang beside the queen's long painted face. A fan-shaped crown, narrow boots and an open gold skirt create a tall, tapered outline.

items.title: Seated Harlequin Nutcracker
items.alt: Plum-and-cream harlequin nutcracker seated on a wooden stool and holding a pale ball.
items.description: The seated harlequin balances a pale ball on one raised hand. Diamond-patterned clothing, a two-point bell hat and long curled shoes spread the composition sideways.

items.title: Baker Nutcracker with Braided Bread
items.alt: Wooden baker nutcracker in a tall chef hat and terracotta apron holding a braided loaf.
items.description: A glossy braided loaf rests on the baker's oval board. The pleated chef hat, auburn beard and flour-marked apron distinguish this round-bodied wooden figure.

items.title: Lantern Miner Nutcracker
items.alt: Grey-jacketed miner nutcracker with an ochre helmet, lantern, walking stick and stone-shaped base.
items.description: The miner leans forward beneath an ochre helmet with a round front lamp. A brass lantern, rough walking stick and uneven base reinforce the sturdy, weathered design.
